title: pvExtractParticlesOverTime
body:
## pvExtractParticlesOverTime

Finds the particles of a temporal point dataset (Particles port) that pass through a volume (Volume port, a dataset with 3-D cells) at any time step, and outputs the Particles data restricted to those particles, still time-dependent. It visits every input time step, so it can be slow. Particles are matched between steps by IdChannelArray. Use it to isolate particles crossing a region such as an inlet or a reaction zone; pvExtractCellsByRegion selects by position at one time only.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- If point order changes between steps and no id array identifies particles, different particles are confused; name an id array in IdChannelArray.
- The Volume must contain 3-D cells; a closed surface does not count as a volume here.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ExtractParticlesOverTime`. Identity: `filters/ExtractParticlesOverTime`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Particles` | Required data input for the native Particles port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: The moving particles. This input should be temporal vtkDataSet and should contain points evolving over time. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":false,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
| `Volume` | Required data input for the native Volume port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: The volumetric data to detect if particles pass through. This dataset should contain volumetric cells like hexahedrons or tetrahedrons. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":false,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `IdChannelArray` | Specify the name of a scalar array which will be used to fetch the index of each point. This is necessary only if the particles change position (Id order) on each time step. The Id can be used to identify particles at each step and hence track them properly. If this array is set to "Global or Local IDs", the global point ids are used if they exist. Otherwise, the point indices are used. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvExtractParticlesOverTime",
  "inputs": {
    "Particles": "UPSTREAM_Particles",
    "Volume": "UPSTREAM_Volume"
  }
}
```
